comparison.objective: Candidate sets and mechanically locks a robot-gripper opening limit; PR-1493 performs a dipstick inspection sequence, reads oil level, reports ADD/OK/OVER, and restores the equipment.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses coaxial tools, differential countertorque, and functional cycling; PR-1493 requires handle-only dipstick extraction/reinsertion, a measured wiping stroke, visual level classification, and puck placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a released 90° stop with retained nuts and ≤2° drift over three cycles; PR-1493 requires a ≥5.4 cm wipe, full reseat, second-pull one-second reading, correct pocket report, final reseating, and rag release, with guessing or blade handling scoring zero.
comparison.reason: The tasks test unrelated physical abilities and outcomes: mechanical adjustment retention versus contamination-safe fluid-level inspection and reporting. PR-1493's available versions include explicit procedure, thresholds, failure cases, and final-state requirements.
